"That I... was careless
  against a mere puppet...

"Curse you...!! Insufferable worms
  to the very end... Guh.
"You felled eight of the ten guardians...

"I am Hunkorvus, granted the power of the
  fallen angel Corvus... I reworked the
  ninth Adventure Log...

"And I am Nelgelas, who gained the power
  of Nelgel, lord of the dead,
  recorded in the tenth Adventure Log.

"Of the guardians born of the great god,
  only we two remain...

"But hatred and despair for you
  are the source of Hunkorvus's power.

"The lord of the dead rules all death.
  As none can escape death,
  none escape me.

"Accursed Hero! This is your grave.
  I'll burn you to ash with
  scorching hellfire!
